title: Selected treasury bill yields
summary: This is a raw statistical data page from the Bank of Canada displaying historical treasury bill yield curves at multiple maturities (1-month through 1-year) across five weekly observations from late February through late March 2026. The page contains no analysis, commentary, or policy interpretation—it is purely a data query/download interface with numerical yield snapshots. It offers no macro catalyst content and has no publication date.
